ordersText.general: During this orbital strike, gain 1 [D], and if the target world becomes neutral after the strike, you may destroy 1 participating Corsair Ship to place a free Trouper on the target world. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: BRILLIANT PERFORMANCE
ordersText.general: When you resolve this order, you may spend 1 forge token to increase your command level by 1 for the purpose of purchasing either 1 Combat upgrade or 1 Order upgrade. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: SWITCHING ROLES
ordersText.general: Before resolving this order, you may replace 1 friendly structure in the active system with a different structure for free. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: THOROUGH REHEARSAL
ordersText.general: When resolving this order gain 1 (S) at the beginning of a combat for every [D] you cannot roll due to the eight-dice limit. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

ordersText.title: THE PLAY BEGINS
ordersText.general: Enemy bastions do not prevent this orbital strike. During this orbital strike, you may spend any of your [D] and destroy any number of ships participating in this strike to either place 1 free Trouper on the target world for every ship destroyed and [B] spent or to place 1 free Death Jester on the target world for every ship destroyed and [M] spent. This can start a combat after resolving the orbital strike. *newline* LIMIT ONCE PER ROUND.

eventsText.title: A MORBID JEST
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Discard this card at the start of a combat on a world. For the duration of this combat, your reinforcement tokens are considered to be Death Jesters.

eventsText.title: OBSESSIVE PRECISION
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Discard this card at the start of a combat, after rolling the dice, to convert 4 of your [D] to [B], [S], or [M] in any combination.

eventsText.title: SLIPPERY AS SILK
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Discard this card when you resolve an advance order. You may move up to 2 units through a single contested void during the ground units movement phase.

eventsText.title: THEATRE OF WAR
eventsText.general: *newpara* Place this card in your play area and discard all of your other schemes. *newpara* Discard this card at the start of the reinforce step of a combat. For the duration of this combat, all units' combat values and morale values are swapped.

eventsText.title: SPECTACLE OF DEATH
eventsText.general: *newpara* Choose a system with a friendly void and an enemy world. Execute an orbital strike of the enemy world collecting [D] equal to the sum of the combat values of your units in the chosen friendly void. (This orbital strike is not considered to be a part of an advance order resolution.)

eventsText.title: NOMADIC TROUPE
eventsText.general: *newpara* Either destroy a friendly structure to gain 1 cache token, 1 forge token and 1 reinforcement token, or destroy a friendly city to gain 2 cache tokens, 2 forge tokens and 2 reinforcement tokens.

eventsText.title: ENCORE
eventsText.general: *newpara* Resolve an advance order in any system. During this order resolution you cannot move ground units, initiate combat or perform an orbital strike.

eventsText.title: UNMASKING
eventsText.general: *newpara* Destroy a friendly Trouper and a friendly Death Jester on the same world to place a free Solitaire on that world.

combatText.title: TROUPE OF LIGHT
combatText.general: If it is not the last combat round, gain 1 (B). *newpara* If it is the last combat round, gain 2 (S).
combatText.unit: Trouper/Corsair Ship: Gain 1 (B) or 1 (S) for every friendly void in the active system.

combatText.title: TROUPE OF TWILIGHT
combatText.general: If you have more [B] than your opponent, he must lose 1 [D] of his choice. *newline* If you have more [S] than your opponent, reroll up to 2 [D]. *newline* If you have more [M] than your opponent, place 1 free reinforcement token in this area.
combatText.unit: Trouper/Death Jester/Corsair Ship: Place 1 free reinforcement token in this area.

combatText.title: TROUPE OF DARK
combatText.unit: Trouper/Corsair Ship: You may retreat 1 unit. If you did, rally the retreated unit and place 1 free reinforcement token in this area. *newpara* Gain 1 materiel for each friendly unit destroyed during this execution round.

combatText.title: LAST LAUGH
combatText.general: Spend up to 3 [B] to force your opponent to lose an equal number of [B].
combatText.unit: Trouper: If you are defending, you may move 1 friendly unit to a an adjacent area. This can start another combat after resolving this combat, and if it does, you are considered the attacker.

combatText.title: FROM THIN AIR
combatText.general: Move a unit from a friendly area in the active or an adjacent system to this area (via a legal movement path). Gain [D] equal to its health value.
combatText.unit: Trouper/Corsair Ship: Rally a unit. Reroll 1 [D].

combatText.title: LETHAL ART
combatText.general: Cards in play do not provide combat icons until the end of the current combat round.
combatText.unit: Death Jester/Starveawer/Solitaire/Corsair Ship: spend 2 [D] to gain 2 [B], 2 [S] or 2 [M].

combatText.title: HOLO-SUITS
combatText.unit: Trouper/Death Jester/Corsair Ship: When your units would be destroyed during this round of combat, they may retreat instead.

combatText.title: SPIRAL OF MIRTH AND MADNESS
combatText.unit: Death Jester: Spend up to 2 (S). For every (S) spent, destroy 1 Corsair ship in an adjacent friendly void to place 1 Trouper on this world.

combatText.title: SHRIEKER CANNONS
combatText.general: Gain 1 (B) for every [B] you have, up to 4.
combatText.unit: Death Jester/Corsair Ship: Destroy an enemy unit of a CL equal to or less then [M] you have, unless your opponent spends a number of [D] equal to its CL (of his choice).

combatText.title: SPECTACLE OF DEATH
combatText.general: Reroll any of your [S], then you may force you opponent to reroll the same number of [S].
combatText.unit: Starweaver/Corsair Ship: Whenever a friendly unit is routed or destroyed during this execution round, gain 2 (B).

combatText.title: ONTO THE STAGE
combatText.general: Choose a friendly unrouted unit. Spend [D] equal to its health value to gain 1 [S] for every [D] spent and to additionally gain 1 (B) for every [M] spent.
combatText.unit: Starweaver: Destroy 1 Corsair Ship in an adjacent fiendly void to purchase a Trouper, Death Jester or Starweaver, reducing its cost by 2, and place it on this world.

combatText.title: CEGORACH'S REVENGE
combatText.general: Convert 1 of your [D] to [S]. Rally a unit.
combatText.unit: Starweaver: If you are attacking, your opponent cannot gain (B) during this execution round and you gain 1 (B). *newline* If you are defending, your opponent loses all of his (B). Gain an equal number of (B).

combatText.title: THE FINAL ACT
combatText.unit: Solitaire: Gain 1 (B) for every [S] your opponent has and every shield icon on your opponent's combat cards in play. If a friendly Solitaire is destroyed during this round, do not discard your (B) at the end of the next assess damage step.

combatText.title: HARLEQUIN'S CARESS
combatText.unit: Solitaire: If you have exactly 1 unrouted unit, deal 4 damage to enemy units, distributing it as you like. Then gain 1 (S) for every unit destroyed and lose 1 (S) for every unit routed.
